review: All monster records were read directly against English. The final player-facing name field was translated for every record, using the frozen glossary for slimes, bats, cave insects, Dust Sprite, Duggy, crabs, ghosts, golems, skeletons, serpents, Magma Sprites, Shadow creatures, Mummy and Pepper Rex. Source display-name reuse for Iridium Golem and Truffle Crab was retained. Stats, movement, drops, defense, experience and mine-progression metadata remain exact.
